name: Ice Bolt
description: A razor-sharp arrowhead of ice crystals forms from a frost orb, launches with blue-white streaks and a frozen mist trail, and shatters into a radial star of shards.

metadata.reference: Ice Bolt concept sheet: fast piercing crystalline projectile with a cold trail. 1 cast 0-0.3 (frost orb of swirling blue energy), 2 form 0.3-0.6 (shards converge into an arrow), 3 launch 0.6-0.8 (streaks), 4 flight 0.8-1.9 (long mist trail, tumbling fragments, snowflakes), 5 impact 1.9-2.6 (radial star of ice shards, frost ring, mist).
metadata.analysis: The head is a rigid cluster of 29 seeded crystal meshes parented to an invisible anchor whose local +X is the direction of travel; every blade has its own seed, facet count, irregularity, flatten scale, tint and emissive, and keyframed local position/rotation/scale so the cluster assembles during `form` and explodes during `impact`. Sprites carry the streaks, mist, snowflakes and sparkles; two procedural volumes carry the frost orb and the frozen mist column.
